protocol.selection: Existing 256 training and 64 development clips; fresh 128 confirmation clips.
protocol.development_rule: Both simulated accuracies improve at least 0.05; clean drops at most 0.03.
protocol.confirmation_rule: Same accuracy rule plus fake recall must not fall for either channel.
protocol.deployment: Never automatic: requires separate real playback validation and fresh physical test.
protocol.limitation: Synthetic randomized channels, not measured room responses; unknown speaker independence.
